*[[4 May 2023 Serbia shootings]]
**Eight people are killed and 14 others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] in and around [[Mladenovac]], [[Belgrade]], [[Serbia]], after an argument broke out in a school backyard. *Following a multi-[[U.S. state|state]] manhunt in the [[United States]], Corey Harrison, the last of four men who escaped from a [[Mississippi]] jail last month, is taken into custody, according to authorities. Previously, two escapees were found dead in [[Carthage, Mississippi]], and [[New Orleans]], [[Louisiana]], respectively, while another was captured in [[Texas]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/05/04/us/mississippi-jail-escape-captured/index.html (CNN)]
